Très bel appartement ! 
Bien situé, très bien équipé !!
Je conseille cet appartement !

Book this place you won’t regret it.  Clean, great location, excellent host.  We were a family of four exploring Barcelona for the first time and were given great tips by Pilar.  The apartment was a lovely space with everything you need for a great stay.

Nice apartment 
Near La Rambla
Every thing nice and clean but there are 2 rooms with bed small little bit 

Nice place to stay 
I suggest
Best regards

Home away from home.  This is our fourth stay with Alex/Javi and Pilar.  Each time has been exceptional.  The apartment is always fully stocked.  Additional items like water, beer, cola, cookies were provided.  Pilar is a joy and has always been there to greet us.   Check in and out is always easy.  I would definitely recommend this apartment to everyone.

Excellent location!  We walked everywhere!  The neighborhood is safe and convenient. Our hosts met us to check in right on the time we designated. The apartment is a good size. We had 3 of us stay. The only issue was hot water, but we worked that out by splitting shower times between morning and night. Overall a great place in the heart of Barcelona.

Stayed in Alex’s apartment for 2 nights with a family of five. We drove in from Valencia in minivan and were met by Pilar, who does not speak any English but was very friendly and helpful with a lot a helpful local info. There is secure parking, but it is VERY tight, and not meant for minivans.  It was somewhat amazing that I made it in and out without any damage to the vehicle.  The apartment is in a decent area, close to metro stops and good restaurants, especially in Poble-Sec, but going a few blocks into El Raval it gets a little scuzzy and I would avoid at night. It is a pretty easy mile walk to the old town/plaza Catalunya area.  The apartment is nice and clean and very functional if not luxurious. One bedroom with a larger bed, and two smaller bedrooms with beds that can really only sleep one adult/teen. The couch can be used as a bed, although not overly comfortable. Two nice bathrooms. Washer and dryer very convenient. Kitchen area was very nice, and the hosts even left some beers and cokes.  Nice little supermarket just 2 doors down. Alex was a good communicator, and was flexible about checkout time for us. Recommended.
Great place. Would recommend to others.

Gostei!
...espero poder voltar!

Spacious apartment in central Barcelona. Pilar was a lovely host and gave us many tips on transportation and where to go. She kindly guided us into our parking space in a tight garage:) Apartment lovely and clean, we may have used more than our fair share of Nespresso pods during our stay. The washer and dryer where terrific.  Apartment well equipped!

Our stay in Barcelona was the last stop in 3 European cities as well as our third airbnb of the trip.  Travel issues delayed our arrival until 11pm but we were still personally greeted by our host, given a tour of the apartment and provided complimentary beer, coffee, soda and advice on seeing the sights of Barcelona. This was a huge contrast from the other two stays where we did not meet our hosts at all. The apartment was clean, perfectly equipped, and in an awesome energetic area.

The apartment is situated within easy walking distance of the port area and not far from the famous La Rambla. There are lots of restaurants and bars close by.
We were welcomed by the lovely Javi who, despite limited English, explained everything and gave us plenty of advice on where to visit and where to avoid. We would certainly stay there again.
Great for tourism. Nice guests. Full equiped flat with securised parking place.

This spotless, beautiful apartment is the perfect base from which to explore Barcelona. Pilar was waiting for us in front of the building when we arrived, and even though her English and our Spanish/Catalan is limited, we had no trouble understanding the very thorough instructions/advice/tips she gave us upon check-in.  Lovely touches throughout, e.g., blackout shades, refrigerated drinks, Nespresso, bath gel.  The beds are super comfy; there is a wonderful view from the master bedroom and living area; and the sounds of the city are muffled (so we slept well at night).  It was also extremely handy to have access to a washer/dryer.  We would stay here again in a heartbeat.

We rented the apt. for 2 night before going on a cruise. It was just as they described!! Very clean and they left drinks and snacks which was a special touch. Great location with market and bars and restaurants very close by.

Pilar personally met us in the front door. The place is super clean. The beds are all comfortable. You have almost everything you need when you wish to cook your own meals. The grocery is just around the corner. Not far from the metro station. I would definitely love to come back.
This place was AMAZING. The flat was clean,  it was in a centrally located area, and the hosts were very accommodating. 10/10 would recommend staying at their flat.

Nous recommandons cet appartement très agréable et très bien équipé. Seul petit bémol pour un des lits deux places qui est petit. Les hôtes sont très réactifs et disponibles et ils mettent tout en oeuvre pour rendre service.

Las fotos son muy reales y las atenciones de Pilar muy buenas. Además de dejarnos un surtido de bebidas y los elementos necesarios para nuestro bienestar nos hizo recomendaciones de cómo movernos más cómodamente y estuvo siempre a nuestra disposición .muy agradecidos.

We had a great stay in the apartment. It is not huge but ideal for 4 or 5 people with every amenity you need. The communication with Alex was excellent at all times. Pilar is a gem. What a lovely helpful lady. We wanted to take her home with us. There are lots of restaurants nearby, the Tapas street was a 10 min walk, the train station is 5 mins away and the Sant Antoni market 5 mins away too. The parking was essential for us and with an ever enthusiastic Pilar guiding us into the tight parking garage, all was safe for our stay. We appreciated the free beer,coke and biscuits and Pilar even paid for our coffees at the cafe below when we arrived earlier than expected! Not her fault...ours! Nice place, great people.

This apartment is great for families.  The special touches of beer, sodas, coffee and bathroom supplies were a sweet surprise.  The apartment is within walking distance to La Rambla and Poble-Sec.  You can catch the Metro just two blocks away and easily travel the city. There are 5 grocery stores within the block to get any supplies you need. The beds were comfy and the AC worked great.  The washer and dryer were such a bonus and they even left washer pods for us to use. If you are going to Barcelona, this is a great place.

Traveling with our two son's this was the perfect apartment in many ways.  The space itself was more than adequate as each boy had his own room and shared a bath.  Beds were comfortable.  Rooms adequately dark for sleeping and the AC worked great.  The living space was comfortable.  Provided toiletries, coffee and beer were nice touches and appreciated.  The location w as a great place to explore all of Barcelona's greatest hits.  Las Ramblas is a 10 minute walk, the subway less than 5.  Cabs are easily accessible one block away.  We discovered the neighborhood was equally vibrant and found some nice restaurants and bars.  Great place, great communication, great stay.

This was a great apt in a fairly newly rehabbed building. Good elevator, secure doors, nice view from the penthouse. Great A/C. The fridge even came stocked with a few beers, cokes and waters. No less than 3 grocery stores in a 3 block radius.

Pilar greeted us and couldn't have been nicer. She spent time showing us the whole map of Barcelona. Location was stellar; close to Metro stops, 15-20 minute walk to La Rambla. Neighborhood seemed very safe, lots of nice little shops everywhere. We had the most fun on Blai St, which is a walking street full of tapas bars about 10 minutes walk in the Poble Sec. La Tasqueta de Blai! Highly recommended. Closest metro stop connects right to the Mt Montjuic funicular for a fantastic view of the city and the old castle up there and surrounding parks. To save money, consider riding up and walking down through all the gardens. 

The Passieg de Gracia is the area where the Gaudi house and Casa Mila are located, and is a beautiful wide walking street. You will be absolutely amazed at the amount of street cafes. 

Also, the L3 green line is at the closest stop, Paral.lel, and it connects directly to the Aeropuerto Train for 4.60E. Little did we know the Gay Pride parade was scheduled for 5 PM on the Paral.lel two blocks away. Entertaining if you're open-minded.

The apartment itself is compact but well appointed with plenty of room for atleast 5 people. All the amenities are modern and well maintained and we appreciated the child friendly crockery and cutlery as well as the fact that there were basic food supplies as well as thoughtful touches like the cold beer and other beverages for us in the fridge. 
The apartment is a stone's throw away from interesting bars and food places and commuting was not a problem at all. 
Alex was wonderful enough to agree to babysit our children for one evening when we made a last minute plan to attend the JayZ/Beyonce concert in Barcelona and he also ended up helping with our laundry and dishes as well. Such a treat!
The one thing I would ask future occupants who are driving a car to be aware of is that the parking space in the garage is extremely tight and it is a very stressful experience parking the vehicle in the space assigned to us. My husband who is an expert driver ended up denting our rental car (remember to always pay that little extra for comprehensive insurance) twice trying to negotiate those turns. 
All in all, a beautiful, sunny, well ventilated apartment with modern amenities and fabulous hosts. We would return in a heartbeat!

A great apartment with a lift and arriving to find cold drinks and coffee pods waiting for us was wonderful! Pilar was very accommodating when we arrived earlier than planned and showed us how everything worked in the apartment. The beds were comfy and we all slept well. Our rental car was an Alfa Romeo Stalvio and the carpark was a struggle to get to and got scratched. Also an FYI, we went out on the first night and headed right which wasn’t so desirable at night but turning left for dinner the next 2 nights worked out better.

Apartment as described. Great location.  Easy walk to town center. Fantastic hosts - leaving cold drinks in the fridge for us after our long drive. Communication was excellent. Free parking on site is also another great bonus.
Great hospitality!  Great apt!

This is the perfect apartment for a stay in Barcelona! There is a parking space with the flat, which is safe and secure and accessible via a lift from the apartment. Our hosts were fantastic, excellent communication ahead of our stay and then Pilar met us at the apartment to check us in and show us around the flat.

The flat itself is spacious and very clean. There is air con, which was brilliant (it was 36C when we visited) and the fridge was stocked with beer, soft drinks and milk - such a nice touch.

It was about a 10/15 minute walk from La Rambla, a perfect location for sightseeing. We would absolutely stay here again.

We loved this place. The apartment was perfect, very spacious and comfortable and had everything we needed. The air conditioning was particularly welcome! We hope to come back some time and would wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone. Great, helpful hosts and a wonderful location.

Alex, Pilar en Javi verhuren een prachtig appartement mét parkeerplaats in garage in het centrum van Barcelona, slechts vijftien minuten lopen van La Rambla. Omringt door talloze eetgelegenheden en op steenworp afstand van een recent geopende overdekte markt. De ontvangst is hartelijk en de toelichting op wat er allemaal te beleven is uitermate uitgebreid - super! Ook het openbaarvervoer is dichtbij. Het appartement is netjes, de ijskast gevuld met bier, water en frisdrank. Daarnaast is de keuken voorzien van alle gemakken. De slaapvoorzieningen zijn voldoende voor twee volwassenen en drie kinderen, maar maximaal vier volwassenen. Kortom, wij raden dit appartement zeker aan!

Appartement très bien équipé, fonctionnel avec parking, parfait pour une famille, dans Barcelone !
On recommande!!!
Accueil et départ très bien géré, avec beaucoup de flexibilité.

We really enjoyed our stay at Alex, Javi and Pilar’s! The hosts are very friendly and flexible. The location of the flat is fantastic too. The parking was especially useful as we came with a car. Highly recommended!

Appartement tout confort avec parking, bien situé (20 min à pieds du vieux Barcelone). Accueil très sympathique, sans oublier les boissons au frais dans le frigo !
Wifi de bon débit. Une très bonne adresse !

Had a lovely time staying seven nights in this conveniently-located flat. Everything was more than perfect. The apt exceeded our expectations and was more impressive than the listing description. The location was amazing, everything was easily accessible. The apt itself was clean modern and incredibly comfortable. Tom was easy to communicate with and very generous.

Would love to stay here again when I'm next in town!

Jack's place was in an amazing location and I loved the decor -- reminds me of Northern Europe. The place was spotless; the soil bathmat was a huge plus. Check in and communication went without a hitch as well. Highly recommend this place for everyone who's staying in HK.
位置真的超赞!而且房主回复很及时,非常nice!
想来香港购物的朋友一定要选这里,真的超方便!没有之一!

This is without a doubt the best place to stay when visiting HK. The very centrally located unit is right outside the MTA and close to many great eateries and shops. The space itself is clean, modern, and very comfortable. Jack and Adrian were very quick to answer questions and check in instructions very clear and concise. A great place all around!

We recently stayed in Hong Kong and were thrilled with this place!!! It was a GREAT location and lived up to its previous reviews. It was clean and comfortable, we felt very welcomed in Jack & Adrian’s apartment. It’s location to the MTR makes for getting around HK very easy! We would recommend this flat to anyone looking for a convenient location in Hong Kong!!!

Great location, very thoughtful host, cozy atmosphere in the apartment, clean and stylish. Definitely worth of visiting again!!!

Super Convenient location at the heart of Causeway station; Bedroom is quite spacious, better than expected. The host and co-host replied to questions very quickly. I would definitely recommend this apartment to other guests.
Jack and Adrian’s place was clean, stylish, and located in a great location in HK. Would stay here again next time we are in town!
Awesome!
Outstanding service provided and a great place to stay at! Very clean, good location, and a very helpful host! Highly recommended.

The host was very hospitable and provided us with lots of information. The location is central and the MTR - local metro - is just opposite the building. A bit noisy at night but if you walk and enjoy the city throughout the day you’ll sleep well.

We truly enjoyed the stay at Jack's place. The location is great -- close to many restaurants, shops, and the MTR station. We took a taxi from the airport (just over 400 HK dollar) and had no problem finding the place. The room is very clean and comfortable. The communication is great. The room is bit small, but is fine for two persons. I would recommend this place.

Jack's place is stylish, trendy, and such a convenient location in Hong Kong! Jack and Adrian respond very quickly, and overall were amazing hosts. Perfect place for a couple or two best friends to stay at!
设施完善;转换器,充电线,棉花棒,很多没有想到的物品,都一应俱全!回应很迅速!

Jack and his co-hosts are incredibly responsive with any questions you may have. His place was very thoughtfully and carefully prepared with all the amenities that a traveler may need (including multiple local USB adapters!). There isn't a washer or dryer in the apartment but this should not be an issue as there are multiple inexpensive laundry services within minutes from the apartment. Jack's place is truly in the heart of Causeway Bay where MTR, restaurants, and shops are just outside the door.
地段非常好,购物非常方便,性价比很高,卫生也很干净,去香港值得入住

Jack and team were very responsive and helpful in answering our questions. The check-in process was seamless. The apartment was updated, clean and in a great location right next to an MTR exit. Overall, we had no issues and recommend this place to others.
Very cosy and well-designed apartment, and the location of Jack’s place is amazing.

小而精致,装修很棒,MUJI风,床也很舒服,不是特别软的那种｡生活用品很齐全｡交通非常非常便利,住宿处离地铁口就100m左右,且楼下附近都是非常地道的餐馆｡离sogo崇光和希慎广场都是300m左右距离,购物完了随时可以放回家!唯一小缺憾,就是房间通风差了一点,即使开了空调也觉得很闷｡瑕不掩瑜,非常喜欢,如果下次再来香港,还是会考虑选择的一家住宿!PS:开始订的三天,后来行程有变取消了一天,房东也非常理解非常爽快的予以变更,非常好的人,谢谢!
位置超级好,铜锣湾地铁c出口30秒就到达,大厦管理挺好的,密码门自助入住,很方便,房子在香港已经比酒店大不少了,尤其是厕所,床品很舒服,还有个小客厅,电视也很好,可惜不会用,要注意的是临街边会有一点吵,还有牙刷早自备,十一这个价格性价比挺高的

Everything you seen in the profile, and pretty much everything you would need for travelling can be found in the flat. Convenient location (exit C of CWB station is right at the corner.) There’s circle K right downstairs, and surrounded by shops/banks/restaurants. There are construction site right outside the window, but the noise was minimal (can bring a pair of earplugs if unsure.)
This is a good location in Causeway Bay. The host was extremely responsive and helpful.
Best place you can get in causeway bay
Excelent location and cozy apartment. The check in and check out were very convinient!

Great place, convenient and quiet.  Jack and Vicky were very helpful with my requests, giving useful info on getting there from airport, and letting us leave luggage at the apartment to pick up later on the day we left.

Jack is a fantastic host with super quick communication and a wonderful apartment in the heart of Causeway Bay with access to the Metro 100m down the street.  The apartment is very comfortable with a separate bedroom, living area and a refreshed modern bathroom.   I had a great stay and would highly recommend!
地理位置可以说非常好了,五分钟就是崇光,正好遇到店庆,很方便!周围交通也便利,唯一需要提醒的就是最好戴个眼罩睡觉
Absolutely amazing host. If you travel to Hong Kong I would most definitely recommend staying with Jack.
地理位置真的超便捷,铜锣湾C口地铁站就在楼下,一兰就在旁边,走三分钟左右就能到达崇光百货､希慎广场,一条线路过去就到达时代广场,想买的的东西附近都能购买到,太完美了;卫生间很大,有个小客厅,装修很简洁,让人感到很舒适,五星好评名副其实!
地理位置非常好,楼下就是各种吃饭的地方,距离崇光百货就只有100米左右的距离,周围有各类网红美食,麦当劳就在楼下,一蘭拉面距离不过50米,sasa和楼上都在100米的距离内｡买东西超级方便｡房间干净卫生,设施非常齐全,房主还有贴心的各类转换插头,进房间时候温水都已经帮我们准备好了｡下次去香港还住你家

the apartment's location was fantastic, right in the heart of the Causeway Bay district. Apartment looks just like what you see in pictures. Great place to stay for short stay as there are no kitchen amenities, but no issue as there are tonnes of food options downstairs. Supermarket is 2min walk away. MTR station is just downstairs. Apartment building had a security post - apartment felt safe. Lovely place! :)
Great place to stay in CWB and the hosts Jack and Vicky were extremely responsive with all questions I had. Really enjoyed the stay in such a cosy apartment!

Nice cosy apartment. The apartment is well equipped with all necessary amenities, such as heating, bathroom and tv. The bed is comfortable.  The apartment is slightly on the smaller side but that’s probably the case with most apartments in HK. The location is excellent, right next to the station and lots of places to eat, etc. The building is on the older side with a lobby and corridors a bit run down but don’t let that fool you. The interiors of the unit are modern and enjoyable. Also special mention to the TV which is enormous and  very nice. Lastly, the host is incredible. We asked him quite a few questions for recommendations etc in the area and he was most obliging and prompt. Overall - three Michelin stars.
Perfect location right off the MTR exit. It’s located to a couple 24 hour convenience stores and everything around is walkable including shopping and restaurants. I would stay here again!

房間一切都很好!
最適合兩人居住!
謝謝Jack
很不错
Very convenient location and a great layout

Super location, in the center of it all but still quiet in the apartment. Would definitely recommend this for a couple looking to experience HK, easy to get to by train/MTR from the airport, clean, secure and good communication, thanks Jack and Vicky!
是个很棒的地方,在香港这来说可以说性价比很高了,喜欢房间里的小细节｡希望下次来香港还能住到!

The place is in a perfect location, in the middle of everything but the apartment is quiet.
 the apartment is stylish, new, clean and it felt good to stay in. 
The hostess were nice, thoughtful and responded very fast.
Defenetly staying there on our next trip as well!

Location location location! Jack's place was right across Causeway Bay MTR station Exit C, where you have easy access to tons of restaurants, shopping malls, and convenience stores that opened till late. Self-check in couldn't be easier. The flat was sparkling clean,  with a stylish interior design. The bed was comfy, and we had a great night staying in. Highly recommended!

Jack's place is a tiny and perfectly situated apartment. It is very clean and comfortable with life going on all around it. I really recommend it if you like to be in the centre of the city. We had a wonderful time and would definitely recommend it.

What a wonderful place to stay! It was our first time using Air bnb and I have to say, Jeremy's place is exactly what we were looking for and more. He was very attentive and helpful with the surrounding areas and his dogs are really sweet and friendly. The places are clean, organized and modern with the Hawaii feel. The laundry room is a major bonus and the full kitchen was great to cook in. Lots of privacy, very peaceful and a beyond beautiful property with an AMAZING view. We will definitely be back. I highly recommend staying here, you can't go wrong. :)
The description was accurate & the property was wonderfully peaceful.

This is place is not what we were expecting, it's definitely beyond expectations!
Countryside, extremely peaceful, surrounded by nature and close from the beach and the towns of Hailewa and Waialua.
Unbeatable location and something that definitely stands for from most of the places listed on Airbnb is definitely Cleanliness, impeccable and super clean.
You will not find any other better listing on the north shore and Oahu in general and for such an unbeatable price.
Jeremy was beyond easy going. We decided to stay 5 more days and definitely recommending and staying here next time we're in Oahu.

Absolutely beautiful place to stay and very comfortable. Nice neighborhood. Incredible views. Great price, affordable, and all the comforts of home were included. The host was quick to respond to our needs and was very friendly and helpful. It was extremely clean and nicely decorated. Plenty of parking and property is gated. Conveniently located to the charming little town of Haleiwa. The owner's two dogs were friendly and adorable. If you are looking for peace and quiet and like listening to the sounds of nature, this is the place for you. We will definitely stay here again on our next Hawaiian vacation. I would highly recommend staying here.
Relaxing and refreshing.

There space was great, and location was perfect. We loved having a kitchen for some healthy meals in, and took advantage of the ripe fruit on the property.  Jeremy responded immediately to all requests and messages.  We had a lovely time!

Our stay was very pleasant. The unit was nice- furnished nicely with lovely views of the mountains beyond some fields. The location necessitates renting a car, but with a car it is a convenient and short drive to Haleiwa. What was surprising was that this unit was in the middle of two other units, like an apartment complex, and on the bottom floor of the main house. It was quiet- we could not hear other renters on either side of us, but would occasionally see them pass by en route to their unit (or we passed by on our way to ours). We could occasionally hear those upstairs walking.
The stay was great! The location was perfect to visit the north shore beaches.

Big place with private bathroom and dinning room with kitchen appliances. The front porch you have a view of nature and fresh air to breath. Everything is great here. Clean bed, clean room and clean toilet. Only 5 minutes drive to Haleiwa town and less than 10 minutes drive to Haleiwa pier and the beach. Mini mart and bakery is by the corner, very convenience.

The place is clean and spacious. Our host welcomed us when we arrived. He was gracious to offer us the mangoes from his garden.

The kitchen is well equipped. So we were able to cook our own meals. Another good thing is the washer and dryer. Washing liquid was provided which was really great. We were able to do our laundry something that you do not always get from AirBnB apartments in Hawaii.

The location is rural and hence you need to drive about 35 min to town. But really close to North Shore Beaches so it is a boon if you like the country. We like the environment and we have spotted two rainbows in the mornings.

The animals were so cute, they smile and look at you.  I was expecting barking because most dogs bark when strangers approach but nope, they just look at you and chill.  The place is definitely secluded.  The beautiful view of the greenery and sky was welcoming. 

Jeremy's amazing!  He was always quick to answer ANYTHING and EVERYTHING I had questions or concerns about.  He went out of his way to walk to our door and hand us fresh picked coconuts!  My fiance and I agree we're DEFINITELY staying here again but hopefully, the get-away instead =) 

Car is a must unless one is willing to do Lyft or Uber around town. Our battery needed a jump start and he was able to do it. We were so grateful.  

Our space was beautiful, high vaulted ceilings, recessed lights, smooth floor plating... if I had more money, I would've stayed longer. Kitchen had coffee, yay! and pots, pans, utensils for cooking, cooking oil, salt and pepper.  Bathroom had fresh clean towels, shampoo was provided, just be sure to bring your own hair dryer.

I loved the privacy sliding door for bathroom as well as the end of the main hallway separating the bedroom and kitchen. 

I wish I didn't fell sick, I was battling a sore tummy and caffeine withdrawals and kept tossing and turning.  However, with the fast internet, I did get my work done, which was a top priority. Our unit was in the center, so we always had to pass one unit and I try not to make any eye contact so I can give the tenants privacy.
Great place, good value.

Great place to stay on the North Shore! Description is very accurate and the large space was fantastic. Quite a few ants but we sprayed Home Defense and that helped. No AC was a little difficult to deal with but made us feel like a local and it stayed cool at night. Beautiful view and wonderful walking distance to a bunch of great places to eat and the beach.

The location is perfect for north shore activities...minutes from Haleiwa for shops and restaurants and beaches. The property itself is next to an area that's populated by many birds of all types. It was great to sit there in the morning and evening listening to birdsong and watching them do their thing. The dogs on the property are very well behaved and friendly.

Everything I could ask for in an Airbnb: host is super responsive, gives you all the information you need, easy check-in/out, location is fantastic, space was exactly as pictured,  very clean and well equipped. Hope it's available next time I'm on the North Shore. 

The North Shore is a very special place and staying here is a great way to experience it.

Host was very responsive to our needs, everything was as it was described. Great location, quiet and serene. Love the dogs, very friendly and made us feel like home. Definitely would stay there again.

The unit was everything as indicated in the photos and description but with one major omission - this is one of three units next to each other. The unit we rented, the "Retreat", was in the middle of the other two units, on the ground floor of the main house. Now, if you place privacy at a premium this is definitely not recommended as a place to stay. The major issue we had is that the other guests (if there were any) would be forced to walk right past you, onto your Lanai (porch) as there is no other path and look right into the unit with its large windows. There is a screen on the lanai (sort of) being shared by the three units but it is not private at all. The curtains also don’t close completely. When we asked the host if it would be possible to move to the unit at the end, because this was definitely not as advertised, his first response was that this would not be possible as other people would be arriving the following day. He then said we could, but at an additional cleaning fee. He also said we were renting the cheapest unit. We went onto the Airbnb site and found the other units, which are both advertised completely separately, but with the same description under different names and they were exactly the same price. In addition, he also replied that "they try to make it apparent on their Airbnb page that there are three units adjacent to each other” - but good luck in finding this description anywhere. 
 
On the positive side, the rooms were large and clean and we were woken up by birdsong in the mornings.

We really enjoyed our stay here. The location was great, away from touristy areas, nice and secluded, you feel like you are somewhere in the middle of the country side. If you want to stay here you definitely need a car to get around. It does get quite hot in the evenings but they have fans to keep you cool. The host is welcoming will help you with any recommendations, the dogs are very friendly too. Couldn't have asked for a better place!

My fiancé and I had a wonderful experience here. We were able to enjoy a peaceful getaway and enjoy the very green scenery of the island. There is plenty of privacy, the host was very responsive and constantly checking on us to be sure we were having a great stay. We had a fridge, stove and oven in our room and access to the washer and dryer. Dogs were super friendly, gated parking. We would definitely stay again.
Very nice place great all around i would diffently stay there again thanks North Shore

We had a great 9 day stay at the country oasis retreat. Our host, Jeremy was very warm and welcoming. He greeted us upon arrival and was always responsive when needed. He gave us a lot of information on things to do in the area. Most of our communication was via email, which was fine for us. He also checked in with us to make sure we had everything we needed. 
The unit was clean, nicely put together and very spacious. Good quality appliances, Full kitchen w/microwave and fridge. Pots, pans, cooking utensils, etc. Enough room for two people and possibly a third.  It was nice and a major plus having washer/dryer access a few step outside of the unit.  Bath and beach towels as well as shampoo and bath wash was there for our use.
The bed was firm. Im not sure it was a queen. Maybe a little smaller but we both slept comfortably every night. A couch and flat screen tv w/hdmi hook up in the bedroom. No A/C but we were very comfortable using the ceiling fans and plug in fan w/window open.  The wifi worked fine. This is also a gated property so we felt safe at night. 
Our unit was in the middle of two others. Great view of the mountains. To enter and leave the units you will need to cross through the neighbors lanai.  We were aware of this in advance and wasn't bothered since we were out most of the day. Just something to consider if you are looking to sit outside in privacy. Loved being greeted by the dogs. They were very well behaved and sweet as pie.  The toads come out at night. I was tickled seeing them hoping around the property when we came back from our adventures. I enjoyed hearing roosters some mornings in the far distance or the beautiful birds singing.  A couple of little lizards here and there but it's to be expected. 
This is a great side of town to visit. Plenty of things to keep you busy during the day and then having a quiet place to come back and rest. It's a good idea to rent a car. We drove all up and down the coast. It is very amazing and the views are simply breathtaking! Make sure to try the cooked snacks at the corner store and try the sno puffs at the bakery up the street. 
You will not be disappointed staying here. We would definitely come back again. :-)
This place was a fantastic getaway on the north shore. The host was very attentive, the view from the porch was exotic, the dogs are very sweet. We really enjoyed our stay here!

Beautiful property in the countryside near Haleiwa. Absolutely blissful, quiet spot. There are neighboring AirBnB guests on either side of you, but we barely saw them while we were at the unit. The host was kind and communicative, but was mostly invisible and out of the way. The bed was comfortable and the unit itself was well-built from high-quality materials. It's a nice place to stay!

The internet is fast – sometimes. I was trying to participate in a work video conference while there (I know, it was a bad way to spend time on Oahu), and the connection sporadically bounced between super fast and almost nonexistent. It could be the local service provider, it could be the distance that the network repeater is from the main unit, or it could be heavy use by others on the network, but it was a problem since the unit is also in an area with poor AT&T coverage so I couldn't use my phone to connect, either.

Regardless, if you're staying here for a few nights, I hope you don't have to spend much time on the computer. There's too much nearby to enjoy!

My dad & I stayed there for a month. We were very welcome by the dogs who are so nice. The place is very cute and calm. The town of Haleiwa is very close 2min driving and the north shore surf spot like pipeline Waimea or sunset aren't that far neither 15 to 20min driving. The place was perfect for what we where looking for. Simple and useful, calm and well situated. Very recommended

Excellent place if you're looking for some peace and quiet. Short 5 min drive to Haleiwa. Great location if you're looking to surf on the north shore. Great restaurants nearby. Would recommend a car for sure though if you really want to get out and check some nearby beaches and hikes. Excellent stay. Full kitchen is always plus.

Great place but do not try to shower during prime time and the sliding doors didn't close. Overall, this was an amazing place and the sunrises were breathtaking. The dogs on the property were really friendly as was the host. I rate this place 8 out of 8 mate, it was great.

Jeremy is absolutely phenomenal. He makes it very easy to check in, and is always there if you need ANYTHING. The space is three individual units at the back of his beautiful house and you have an amazing view. The walls are a little thin (you can hear the TV in the next unit) but everybody I met there was so nice and courteous. The view from your unit will be breathtaking and the accommodations were perfect.
Awesome place!

Everything about the location is perfect for visitors to the North Shore. Easy parking, convenience store nearby (and an ice cream shop and bakery!) and so close to Haleiwa and easy access to everything. Clean and comfy. Gorgeous views. Quiet and relaxing
The unit was great! This is the second time that we've stayed with Jeremy and Jessica, and we would not hesitate to do so again!

This is such a special place! Very clean, comfortable, peaceful, scenic and secure.  We loved the king sized memory foam mattress - we slept like babies - and ample storage provided by the walk-in closet. Next time, we'll stay longer and take advantage of having a full kitchen and deck. We are so very happy with our stay there - just wish it could have been longer. Thank you so much!!

This was our first time staying in an Airbnb. We really enjoyed our stay here! The owners are friendly, the dogs are nice, and the property is beautiful. Great location close to Haleiwa and the North Shore. Just some things to be aware of, the bed is very firm, but probably not too bad if you're used to a firm bed. Also because there are dogs on the property, just be aware of where you step. This did not bother us at all, as we have dogs at home too, just something to pay attention to. We loved having a full kitchen which allowed us to buy some groceries and cook a few meals. Overall, we thought it was great! A fantastic value for the price, and we would definitely stay here again.

This spot is great. It's extremely quiet, very private and the space itself seems new. The location is pretty central for the North shore since you can drive further up to all the surf and beach spots but it's only about 30 minutes to Honolulu. The hosts are making a lot of effort as well. I would definitely stay again.

Jeremy and Jessica are great hosts. They were helpful and friendly. The property is nice and quiet, and we felt very secure there. The dogs were nice and were not a problem at all. The unit was exactly as described and had everything we needed. We would definitely stay here again.
Great spot, stayed twice.

The unit was lovely and exactly what we were looking for. It was clean, spacious and having the kitchen area was nice. We were very comfortable and felt very safe. It was quiet but we could drive to shops/restaurants quickly and without hassle. Next time we're back in the North Shore, we would definitely stay here again.

Jeremy and Jessica were great host. The place was great and we had everything we needed. We were very close to the beach and a shopping center which was very convenient. They have two sweet dogs that come say hi! Would recommend!

Quaint place within walking distance of Haleiwa. Great owners, pleasant and attentive.
 We'd stay here again.
Great place to stay, very comfortable and quiet. Their dog adira is the sweetest

Very accurate and awesome place! This is a one bed/one bath apartment you are renting built on the first floor of the host's beautiful two story home. Our space was the middle space in between two other rooms. Very clean, fully furnished with everything you could need from towels to dishes to pots and pans and laundry just outside the room. For the price and location, you can't beat this place!

This cozy villa is a beautiful modern yet country living home. I can guarantee that the view from the backyard is breathtaking! I facetimed my parents so they could see our view LOL. Adira their dog was so sweet!! At first my boyfriend was a little scared since there was no AC but jeremy informed us about the breeze at night and he accomodated us with fans and it was just perfect! I loved my stay here :D
The house is not far from Haleiwa but it's still a bit far from downtown.  The bed was very hard and uncomfortable and my back hurt after first night.   The place was clean and quiet.
This was a magical and special place to stay. Exactly what we where looking for. Quiet and beautiful location. The host was very welcoming and easy to get in though with. We will stay here again.

Awesome, secluded place. There's a fence to keep the car inside the property. Two sweet dogs. And beautiful views of the mountains and sunset. Super close to restaurants and shops. Very relaxing place to stay.
North Shore Country Living was our first air bnb experience and it was perfect. Definitely reccomend North Shore Country Living if you are looking to stay up at the North Shore for a couple days.

When I got to the apartment, there was major construction (which begins at around (8-9AM) surrounding the apartment (the apartment is on a right angle on a major intersection near Place de Arts) and the music from nearby festivals (very loud) begins in the afternoon and ends late at night at around 11PM-12AM. 

I was aware of how close the festivals were, but based on Raed's comment, I figured it would be relatively quiet and didn't anticipate such loud music and construction. I was a bit annoyed when I got to the apartment and for the first few days, I was bombarded with construction early in the morning and then blaring music for most of the day. This may have been miscommunication, or maybe it is a new issue, but I felt somewhat misled. Now this might not bother anyone else, which is fine. But I did ask about the noise level before I booked. And yet, the experience I had wound up contradicting what I had been told by the host. So make sure you ask specific questions if you have specific concerns. And if you are looking for quiet during the day — good luck!

There was also some initial confusion when trying to book the apartment because the dates that were listed as available were not actually all available. In fact, I had to change my reservation from June 12-26 to June 12-20 because Raed had his own plans with the apartment from the 20th onward but this was not reflected on AirBnB and it wasn’t until after I booked my dates that I found out the the apartment wouldn’t be available after the 20th. This lack of clarity in communication was pretty inconvenient for me. Plus, I had to wait to hear back from and constantly inquire with Raed when trying to find out the actual available dates to see if the apartment was going to be available or not. Even after I booked, the dates listed as available remained inaccurate. If I didn't keep contacting him, I'm not sure how things would have turned out. This put a some stress on my travel plans, which were admittedly very last minute. I realize Raed was probably very busy, but it's always the little, logistical things that matter.

Despite these relatively minor issues, I must state that Raed was very accommodating and responsive during my actual trip, very friendly, and in the end - he was very considerate by allowing me to check out a few days early.

Not fancy, but I suspect fancy people don't use airbnb and actually stay in hotels at Waikiki and pay four times as much as this and have no interest in seeing how real Hawaiians live! We loved staying here. Would suit fit and independent travellers with a sense of adventure wanting to make their trip up as they go along, and see urban sights of Hawaii outside the Waikiki tourist strip. A chance to see contemporary Hawaiian culture in the sights and happenings in the streets around you.

A couple of points to note: if you find the gate latch difficult to open lift the gate up. Bed squeaks a little ;). Stairs to the flat are steep so take care. If you are taking a airport transfer or taxi tell them it is the TOP side of the street above the freeway and give them the crossroad as the street continues both sides of the freeway.

Things NOT to miss in Honolulu all within good walking distance of here: Zippy's Restaurant, Bishop Museum, Chinatown especially the restaurant called The Pig and The Lady, Honolulu Museum of Arts in South Beritania St (sp?). If you are looking for cheap clothes stop at a Ross store, one right in the city centre.

All in all we would definitely stay here again.
